- **Audience:** the brief posts in #strategic-random, whose members are Gideon, Nadia, you and me. All three of those people are also in #inc-vtg-hartford and #strategic-pod, so the summaries won't reveal anything new to them.
- **Exclusions:** I'd leave out money terms, such as rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices and payment terms. Those aren't for this channel unless Anselm or June approves. Seat counts, renewal dates and similar operational facts are fine.

To get this running, someone with gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler credentials. Then tell me and I'll create the 07:45 UTC job and run one test brief before the first scheduled post. Note that the brief times would be in UTC unless you tell me otherwise.
